info.title: Scouting Super Admin API
info.description: API for Super Admin managing Games, Actions, Packages, Clubs, Orders, Invoices, and Platform Settings.

servers.description: Local Development Server (Use 'x-subdomain' header for tenant routes)

SuperAdminAuth.description: Super Admin JWT token returned from POST /api/auth/login

TenantAuth.description: Tenant JWT token returned from POST /api/tenant/auth/login

TenantSubdomain.name: x-subdomain
TenantSubdomain.description: Subdomain of the club (e.g. 'ahly'). Required for /api/tenant/* routes when developing on localhost.

cycle_id.description: The package cycle selected for the current subscription

icon.description: Relative URL of the uploaded icon.

payment_proof.description: Absolute URL of the uploaded payment proof.

approved_by.description: Name of the super admin who approved.

BadRequest.description: Validation error or invalid request body

get.description: Checks server status, uptime, and database connectivity

post.description: Authenticates super admin and returns Bearer JWT token
Stateless JWT: client discards the token

get.description: Returns platform-wide stats, subscription breakdown, revenue chart, top packages, recent orders and upcoming expirations

parameters.name: months
parameters.description: Number of months for revenue breakdown (1-24)

get.description: Returns lightweight active games array for dropdowns. Response key is `items`.

put.description: When `cycles` is sent, existing cycle `_id`s are preserved by matching `_id` first then `name`.

post.description: Registers a new club and provisions its isolated database with initial admin and settings. Admin credentials must be provided explicitly.

cycle_id.description: If omitted, the first cycle of the package is used for date calculation

put.description: `subdomain` cannot be changed (it is the database name).

delete.description: Fails with 409 if the club has orders unless `?force=true` or `?cascade=true`.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Delete even if the club has orders (also deletes those orders)

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Delete even if clubs have orders

get.description: Inspects the isolated MongoDB database of this club and counts rows in teams, players, matches, etc.

post.description: Creates indexes, default settings document and the first club admin (if missing). Admin credentials must be provided.

post.summary: Forgot Club Password (Reset from Super Admin)
post.description: Targets `admin_id`, `email`, or by default `admin@<subdomain>.com`. If no account exists, the default admin is created. Without `password`, a random one is generated and returned ONCE. `activate: true` re-enables a locked account.

password.description: Optional custom password; if omitted a random one is generated

activate.description: Set to true to re-enable a locked account

201.description: Tenant admin created with a new password

example.message: Tenant admin created with a new password

icon.description: New icon file. Send the literal string 'null' to clear the icon.

post.description: If `cycle_id` is provided, `price` and `discount` default to the cycle values. Late renewals automatically get `settings.fines` as `fine` unless overridden. Accepts multipart/form-data if a payment_proof file is uploaded.

price.description: Required if no cycle is selected

put.description: An order already applied to the subscription cannot leave `paid` status. Accepts multipart/form-data to replace payment_proof.

payment_proof.description: New payment receipt image. Send literal 'null' to clear.

delete.description: Order applied to the subscription cannot be deleted.

patch.description: Paid orders cannot be moved back to `pending` or `rejected`. Orders already applied to subscription cannot leave `paid`.

post.description: Marks a pending order as paid and atomically extends the club's `end_date` by the package cycle length.
Only pending orders can be rejected. Orders already applied to subscription cannot be rejected.

reason.example: Payment receipt unreadable or transfer not received

post.description: Fails if any selected order was already applied to a club subscription.

get.description: Returns structured invoice data. Pass `?format=html` to render printable HTML.
Directly returns clean, print-ready HTML page with print button

put.description: Upserts the `global` settings document with the provided fields.

image.description: Image file (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .webp, max 5MB). Also accepts field name `file`.
